item.title: Building My Blog With Hugo and GitHub
item.description: When I first decided to write my blog, I was thrown into bunch of options. I noticed that wordpress.com and medium are popular options when it comes to writing blogs. However, I also noticed that many of the popular options would generally give less control over my blog and require payments to use many of its features. So it became a natural choice for me to just build one myself, which was both a dumb and greatest choice that I ever made. Maybe I can save this for later blogs.
